scientific_integrity.limitations: The n=5 Petersen graph instance was previously known. No assertion for general Kneser k or higher-independence r, no equivariant sphere-wedge homotopy equivalence. Four finite computations corroborate but do not prove the general theorem. Bibliographic novelty remains subject to additional external verification.
scientific_integrity.main_statement: For every integer n>=5, Ind_2(KG(n,2)) is homotopy equivalent to the 3-skeleton of an (n-1)-simplex and to a wedge of C(n-1,4) three-spheres; natural S_n-module on H_3(Z) is exterior fourth power of the augmentation kernel.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact face classification, good-cover nerve, octahedral attaching maps with integral orientations, cellular chain comparison, Hurewicz and Whitehead.

title: Three-sphere wedges and integral symmetry in two-independence complexes of two-subset Kneser graphs
